newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain to build new $79.6 mln causeway.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain to build new $79.6 mln causeway.

text.p: Bahrain plans to start working in 1997 on a 30 million dinar ($79.6 million) causeway linking its capital with a new industrial estate, Public Works and Agriculture Minister Majid al-Jishi said on Tuesday.

Jishi said the new causeway would link the main seaport of Mina Sulman in the capital Manama with the new industrial area in nearby Muharraq island, the Gulf News Agency reported. He said the project would take four to five years to complete.
Jishi said Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa would on Saturday inaugurate a three-km causeway linking Muharraq and Manama, built at a cost of 26.5 million dinars.
Muharraq is currently linked to Manama by a causeway which will undergo renovation once the new bridge is inaugurated. ($1 = 0.377 dinar)
